additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434465-DC/SI-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002442] Charging issue CRM:02678000122
additional_info.body:
Dear Luigi Iodice,
I hope this message finds you well.
We have identified that the charger is currently operating on an outdated firmware version. To ensure optimal performance and potentially resolve the issue, we recommend updating the firmware to the latest version,
FW v7.0
.Once the update is completed, we will closely monitor the system to determine if the issue persists.
If the error recurs following the firmware upgrade, we may need to arrange for field technicians to perform a more thorough on-site inspection and troubleshooting.
Could you please confirm whether the charger can be updated to firmware v7.0? If so, kindly share a suitable date and time so we can schedule and proceed with the update accordingly.
Additionally ,could you please confirm if we can merge cases 0434467, 0434459, and 0434461 to carry out the firmware updates on all the chargers together? This would help us streamline the process and improve efficiency.
Looking forward to your confirmation.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
